name: eClerx Services Ltd
title: eClerx Services Ltd - 532927 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 soft sequentially (operating revenue +0.5% cc QoQ, utilisation 74% vs 76.5% peak) but management held FY27 guidance of top-quartile growth and 24-28% EBITDA margin, with no supply-side capacity signal.

utilisation.quote: Utilization in Q4 is 74%, lower than the eight quarter high of 76.5% that we saw in Q3.

capex.quote: CapEx is up in Q4. This is primarily due to investments in computers and networking equipment.

triggers.label: Utilisation 76.5% → 74% QoQ
triggers.quote: Utilization in Q4 is 74%, lower than the eight quarter high of 76.5% that we saw in Q3.

triggers.label: Q4 operating revenue +0.5% cc QoQ
triggers.quote: in constant currency terms, the operating revenue is up 0.5% sequentially and 17% for the full year.

triggers.label: FY27 top-quartile growth, 24-28% EBITDA held
triggers.quote: For FY '27 also, we are saying that we will be in the top quartile of the growth.

triggers.label: Analytics & automation USD 90m book
triggers.quote: Analytics and automation is now a USD 90 million bo ok.

guidance.quote: we would like to retain the same guidance between 24% to 28%.
For FY '27 also, we are saying that we will be in the top quartile of the growth.
we expect that it should definitely be better than what we did in Q4, if you look at the sequential growth.

prior_guidance_check.quote: for the full year, we will be in the top quartile on the growth and 24% to 28% on EBITDA

red_flags.quote: with almost 23% -24% growth in new ACV

red_flags.label: AI deflation on bookings
red_flags.quote: So , a combination of that may put some deflationary pressures.

evasions.topic: FY27 growth vs FY26 and bookings band
evasions.quote: In terms of whether it will be lower or higher, I think I wouldn't want to comment at this stage.
